literature.title: Sports News and the Artificial-Intelligence-Generated Article: Examining Identity and the Influence of Human Versus Artificial-Intelligence Authorship on Perceptions of Credibility and Online Share Likelihood
literature.title_cn: 体育新闻与人工智能生成文章：检验人类与AI作者身份对可信度感知与在线分享意愿的影响
literature.title_en: Sports News and the Artificial-Intelligence-Generated Article: Examining Identity and the Influence of Human Versus Artificial-Intelligence Authorship on Perceptions of Credibility and Online Share Likelihood
literature.author: Sean R. Sadri, Jessica L. Payne, Kenon A. Brown, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: To better understand factors that influence news credibility and online sharing likelihood of artificial-intelligence (AI) -generated articles, a national survey of U.S. adults was conducted (N = 355). Using a 3 (authorship) × 2 (byline) factorial design, participants were asked to evaluate the credibility of a sports-news article written by a human author or an AI-language model (ChatGPT or Google Gemini), with a byline indicating that the article was written by a human author or AI, and assess the likelihood they would share the article on social media. Participant predictors for article credibility, source credibility, information accuracy, and article-share likelihood significantly differed based on demographics, identity characteristics, and cognitive heuristic factors, while authorship did not significantly influence credibility perceptions or share likelihood. Across both human- and AI-authored articles, level of sport fanship significantly influenced share likelihood and perceived information accuracy. Additionally, article credibility and source credibility were significantly influenced by positive attitudes toward AI, which may signal drastic changes in how audiences will interpret and engage with AI-generated news content.
literature.abstract_cn: 为更好地理解影响AI生成文章新闻可信度与在线分享可能性的因素，本研究对美国成年人进行了全国性调查(N=355)。采用3(作者身份)×2(署名)的因子设计，参与者被要求评价由人类作者或AI语言模型(ChatGPT或Google Gemini)撰写的体育新闻文章的可信度，署名表明文章由人类或AI撰写，并评估其在社交媒体上分享该文章的可能性。分析参与者的文章可信度与分享倾向预测因素，为AI生成新闻的受众接受提供了实证依据。

literature.title: Coaching With Social Media: The Coach–Athlete Performance Team
literature.title_cn: 用社交媒体执教：教练-运动员表现团队
literature.title_en: Coaching With Social Media: The Coach–Athlete Performance Team
literature.author: Elyse Gorrell
literature.abstract: The purpose of this research was to explore coaches’ perceptions of athletes’ social media use. There has not been a thorough examination of social media’s effects on coaches or the consequences of social media for meaningful relations between coach and athlete. This is an important area to investigate because previous literature suggests that social media has psychological ramifications that influence athletes’ behavior; that athletes may not be aware of, or understand, the implications that social media may have; and that athletes do not realize that social media platforms have an effect on their mental game in sport performance. Given that the coach–athlete relationship is important to sport-performance success, it is important to examine coaches’ perspectives on social media’s influence on athletes. Accordingly, a phenomenological approach was utilized to understand this experience. Semistructured interviews were conducted with six high-performance coaches of a variety of individual sports. The interviews underwent a phenomenological-analysis sequence to coconstruct meaning from the data and explore the topic. Although there is limited research on the topic of social media’s impact on coaches, research has recognized that athletes’ preoccupation with social media is a perceived challenge for coaches. The findings from the present study illustrate how coaches observe social media influencing their athletes’ behaviors, the persuasive qualities of social media, and how young athletes navigate their image on social media.

literature.title: Admired Vulnerability or Shattered Heroism? Media Framing of Elite Athletes’ Mental Illnesses in German Print Media
literature.title_cn: 令人钦佩的脆弱还是破碎的英雄主义？德国纸媒对精英运动员精神疾病的媒体框架
literature.title_en: Admired Vulnerability or Shattered Heroism? Media Framing of Elite Athletes’ Mental Illnesses in German Print Media
literature.author: Marcia Hapig, Jannika M. John, Guido Zurstiege, Jochen Mayer, Ansgar Thiel
literature.abstract: This study examines the media’s framing of mental illness among elite athletes in German print media from 2013 to 2023. Traditionally, elite sport culture has glorified invulnerability, marginalized mental health challenges, and stigmatized perceived weakness. Through a reflexive thematic analysis of 200 articles from three major German newspapers, we constructed four dominant frames: mental illness (a) as a bug in the performance-oriented sport system, (b) as a magnifying glass on its dark sides, (c) as a necessary respite, and (d) as a starting point for empowerment. Our findings highlight, on one hand, the persistence of traditional narratives that prioritize performance over well-being while, on the other hand, acknowledging a growing recognition of systemic failures and athletes’ holistic health in the print media. By exploring media constructions, this work advances the discourse on mental illness, stigma, and the evolving cultural transformation of elite sport.

literature.title: Navigating Gender Roles From the Sports Sidelines: Gender Schemas and Industry Expectations of Female Sideline Reporters
literature.title_cn: 在体育边线中游走性别角色：女性边线记者的性别图式与行业期望
literature.title_en: Navigating Gender Roles From the Sports Sidelines: Gender Schemas and Industry Expectations of Female Sideline Reporters
literature.author: Sean R. Sadri, Nicholas R. Buzzelli, Jessica L. Payne, Andrew C. Billings
literature.abstract: Using gender schema theory as a primary theoretical framework, in-depth interviews were conducted with current and former female sideline reporters (N = 17) to provide qualitative insights related to the expectations of their role in the sports-media ecosystem, perceptions about hierarchical gender structures in sports reporting, and the increasing importance of relationship building in the profession. The study determined that a female sideline reporter’s self-perceived contributions to a broadcast can contrast with her interactions with fans, who, interviewees contend, can perpetuate appearance double standards. Interviews also revealed that airtime is not commensurate with broadcast impact because they routinely relay information to producers before and during games, and their daily workload often resembles that of a newspaper sportswriter. Qualitative interviews also determined that gender inequities still exist in sports-media broadcast crews who, in rare cases, have used diminutive terms when talking to female colleagues. In addition, cultivating strong connections with other women in the field and with sources was articulated as useful for maintaining morale and improving storytelling capabilities. The theoretical and professional implications of these findings are discussed.

literature.title: Online Public Opinion Assessment for Sport Events Using Text Sentiment Analysis: A Case Study of Chinese Weibo Responses to the Summer Olympic Games in Tokyo
literature.title_cn: 基于文本情感分析的体育赛事网络舆情评估：中国微博对东京夏奥会反应的案例研究
literature.title_en: Online Public Opinion Assessment for Sport Events Using Text Sentiment Analysis: A Case Study of Chinese Weibo Responses to the Summer Olympic Games in Tokyo
literature.author: Jianjun Li, Yafei Hu, Yile Tang, Qin Zhang, Bo Li
literature.abstract: Sport events play a vital role in shaping national and urban images, attracting significant attention, and influencing online public opinion. Effective monitoring and management of this opinion are essential for the successful execution of these events. This case study examines the characteristics of online public opinions on the Chinese social media platform Weibo during the 2020 Tokyo Olympics using time analysis, text-frequency analysis, and sentiment analysis utilizing tools such as Python, ROSTCM6, and ROSTEA. By establishing an assessment system for online public sentiment and proposing management strategies, this case study provides valuable insights into public opinion trends and offers a theoretical foundation for stakeholders to respond effectively.

literature.title: Streaming Live From Paris: Comparison of the Broadcast Commentaries of the Olympic and Paralympic Volleyball Tournaments
literature.title_cn: 从巴黎现场直播：奥运与残奥排球赛事转播解说的比较
literature.title_en: Streaming Live From Paris: Comparison of the Broadcast Commentaries of the Olympic and Paralympic Volleyball Tournaments
literature.author: Kelsey Slater, Noah Backes
literature.abstract: The 2024 Paris Olympic and Paralympic Games both increased the total amount of media content through NBCUniversal’s television and streaming services compared to the Tokyo 2020 broadcasts, with thousands of hours of live sports coverage available across the globe. Previous Olympic research primarily focused on prime-time coverage, which is often limited to certain sports. This research sought to expand broadcast-commentary scholarship related to sport diversity through the comparative examination of the framing of Olympic and Paralympic volleyball on the NBC streaming service Peacock. The streaming content was examined to determine differences in media treatment of the Olympic and Paralympic athletes, as well as male and female volleyball athletes, during the 2024 Paris Olympic and Paralympic Games. The results suggested that while all athletes were framed as athletically talented, male Paralympians were more often characterized as strong and focused compared to their Olympic counterparts. At the same time, the backgrounds and experience of Olympic athletes were more likely to be mentioned than those of the Paralympic athletes. Further differences and implications are discussed.
literature.abstract_cn: 与东京2020转播相比，2024年巴黎奥运会和残奥会都通过NBC环球的电视和流媒体服务增加了媒体内容总量，全球范围内提供了数千小时的直播体育报道。以往奥运研究主要聚焦于黄金时段报道，而这往往局限于某些体育项目。本研究旨在通过比较考察2024巴黎奥运会和残奥会期间NBC流媒体服务Peacock上奥运和残奥排球比赛的框架，扩展与体育多样性相关的转播评论学术。研究者考察了流媒体内容，以确定2024巴黎奥运会和残奥会期间媒体对奥运和残奥运动员以及男女排球运动员待遇的差异。结果表明，尽管所有运动员都被呈现为具有运动天赋，但男性残奥运动员比其奥运同行更常被描述为强壮和专注。同时，奥运运动员的背景和经历比残奥运动员更可能被提及。文章讨论了进一步差异及其意涵。

literature.title: “When I’m in China, I’m Chinese”: Olympic Media, Nationalism, Identity, and Performance in the Controversial Case of Eileen Gu
literature.title_cn: “在中国我是中国人”：谷爱凌争议案中的奥运媒体、民族主义、身份与表演
literature.title_en: “When I’m in China, I’m Chinese”: Olympic Media, Nationalism, Identity, and Performance in the Controversial Case of Eileen Gu
literature.author: Zituo Wang
literature.abstract: Past studies have shown how Olympic media influence audiences’ nationalistic attitudes, yet the mechanism of constructing nationalism through sport-media events remains unclear since a key factor is missing—the athlete. Drawing on social identity and postcolonial theories, I examine how Olympic media impacted Chinese audiences’ nationalistic attitudes during the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympic Games, particularly regarding Eileen Gu, who switches from representing the United States to China. To investigate the relationship between media exposure and nationalism, I proposed a mediation model and surveyed 327 Chinese audiences. Results show that the more media about Gu the audiences are exposed to, the higher levels of nationalistic attitudes they hold; Gu’s perceived identity and performance fully mediate the relationship between media exposure and nationalistic attitudes. This study contributes to social identity theory by revealing how athlete-centered sport communication shapes postcolonial nationalism through mediated perceptions of identity and performance.
literature.abstract_cn: 过往研究已表明奥运媒体如何影响受众的民族主义态度，然而通过体育媒介事件建构民族主义的机制仍不清楚，因为缺少一个关键因素——运动员。本研究借鉴社会认同理论和后殖民理论，考察了2022年北京冬奥会期间奥运媒体如何影响中国受众的民族主义态度，尤其关注从代表美国转而代表中国的谷爱凌。为考察媒体曝光与民族主义之间的关系，研究者提出了一个中介模型，并对327名中国受众进行了调查。结果显示，受众接触的关于谷爱凌的媒体越多，其持有的民族主义态度水平就越高；谷爱凌的被感知身份和表现完全中介了媒体曝光与民族主义态度之间的关系。本研究通过揭示以运动员为中心的体育传播如何经由对身份和表现的媒介化感知来塑造后殖民民族主义，为社会认同理论作出了贡献。
literature.theoretical_framework: 受众研究理论、媒介事件理论

literature.title: Sponsoring Esports to Facilitate Positive and Prevent Negative Image Transfer: The Moderating Effects of Event–Sponsorship Fit
literature.title_cn: 赞助电竞以促进正向、预防负向形象转移：赛事-赞助契合度的调节效应
literature.title_en: Sponsoring Esports to Facilitate Positive and Prevent Negative Image Transfer: The Moderating Effects of Event–Sponsorship Fit
literature.author: Jae (Alex) Ko, Minkyo Lee, Bumsoo Park
literature.abstract: Despite the potential risks of negative associations’ affecting the sponsoring brand, prior sponsorship literature has not delved into this area. Consequently, the purpose of the current study was to investigate how negative and positive image associated with an esports event could be transferred differently to a sponsoring brand based on the level of fit between the brand and the event. The current research adopted the concept of negativity bias to explore how negative associations linked with an esports event might impact the perception of a sponsoring brand compared with positive associations associated with the same event. The authors conducted experiments involving 215 online participants, focusing on a single factor: the level of fit between the brand and the event (high vs. low). The findings revealed that negative associations were more likely to be associated with the sponsoring brand compared with positive associations. Furthermore, in conditions where there was a high fit between the event and the sponsoring brand, positive associations were more prone to transfer to the brand than negative ones. However, when the fit between the event and the sponsoring brand was low, no significant difference in image transfer was observed. This study enriches understanding of how both positive and negative associations can be transferred, contingent upon the level of event–sponsor fit, thereby underscoring the potential adverse consequences of esports sponsorships. Incongruent firms are advised to explore alternative forms of fit, such as image-based similarity, when selecting an esports event to mitigate negative image transfer while fostering positive associations.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管负面联想影响赞助品牌存在潜在风险，既有的赞助文献尚未深入探讨这一领域。因此，本研究的目的是调查与电竞赛事相关的负面和正面形象如何依据品牌与赛事之间的契合度，以不同方式转移给赞助品牌。当前研究采用负性偏差（negativity bias）概念，探讨与电竞赛事相关的负面联想相比同一赛事相关的正面联想，会如何影响对赞助品牌的感知。作者进行了一系列涉及215名在线参与者的实验，聚焦于单一因素：品牌与赛事之间的契合度（高vs.低）。研究结果显示，负面联想比正面联想更有可能与赞助品牌相关联。此外，在赛事与赞助品牌契合度高的条件下，正面联想比负面联想更倾向于转移到品牌上。然而，当赛事与赞助品牌契合度低时，形象转移没有观察到显著差异。本研究丰富了关于正面和负面联想如何根据赛事—赞助契合度水平进行转移的理解，从而凸显了电竞赞助潜在的负面后果。建议与赛事不契合的企业在选择电竞赛事时探索其他形式的契合（如图像相似性），以减轻负面形象转移，同时促进正面联想的形成。
literature.theoretical_framework: 游戏研究、媒介文化理论

literature.title: Xu Versus Wushu: Synecdoche and Apologia in Nationalized Sports Losses
literature.title_cn: 徐晓明对阵武术：民族化体育失利中的提喻与辩解
literature.title_en: Xu Versus Wushu: Synecdoche and Apologia in Nationalized Sports Losses
literature.author: Mike Milford
literature.abstract: Nationalized sports are powerful rhetorical tools for collective identity and ideology. Nations often hold up athletes, teams, and contests as emblematic of core values. However, the competitive nature of sports means that those representatives, or synecdoche in rhetorical terms, may come up short. In such cases, nations must address the embarrassment the losses incur. Nations use apologia and image-repair strategies to mitigate the damage that shortfalls cause to repair and protect the connections the nations have with their sports synecdoche. The interaction of the uncertainty of sports, synecdoche, and apologia is the essence of this analysis. This essay analyzes responses of the Chinese state-run media to a series of defeats that traditional Chinese martial artists faced against MMA (mixed martial arts) fighters. The government had long used traditional martial arts as a synecdoche of its culture. The losses incurred threatened those representations, and state media engaged in an apologia campaign to alleviate the damage.
literature.abstract_cn: 国家化体育是建构集体认同与意识形态的强有力修辞工具。国家常将运动员、队伍和赛事视为核心价值观的象征。然而，体育的竞争性意味着这些代表（即修辞学意义上的"提喻"）可能表现失利。在这种情况下，国家必须应对失利带来的尴尬。国家运用辩护修辞（apologia）和形象修复策略来减轻失利造成的损害，以修复和保护国家与体育提喻之间的联系。体育结果的不确定性、提喻与辩护修辞之间的相互作用正是本分析的核心。本文分析了中国官方媒体对传统中国武术运动员在与MMA（综合格斗）选手对抗中遭遇一系列失利所作出的回应。政府长期将传统武术作为其文化的提喻象征。这些失利威胁到了这一象征，官方媒体随即发起了一场辩护修辞运动以减轻损害。

literature.title: All the Same? Expectations and Evaluations of Sports Journalistic and Sports Organizations’ Instagram Channels by Young Adults
literature.title_cn: 都一样？年轻人对体育新闻与体育组织Instagram频道的期望与评价
literature.title_en: All the Same? Expectations and Evaluations of Sports Journalistic and Sports Organizations’ Instagram Channels by Young Adults
literature.author: Inga Oelrichs, Mark Ludwig
literature.abstract: Social media is the main source of information for young adults. In networks like Instagram, they encounter a range of information from both journalistic media providers and sports organizations (e.g., clubs and federations). If these two types of channels are perceived as interchangeable offerings, journalistic channels risk losing relevance. Based on the uses and gratifications approach and on models for conceptualizing journalistic quality, the objective of this study was to explore (a) what young adults expect and receive from sports journalistic and sports organizations’ channels and (b) whether their assessment of the two types of channels differ. A survey (N = 687) was used to assess the gratifications sought and obtained, as well as quality expectations of and experiences with sports journalistic and sports organizations’ channels on Instagram in Germany. Results reveal that sports journalistic and sports organizations’ channels are perceived in a similar manner. One major implication for journalism is the need for further differentiation.

literature.title: Discrimination and Deterrents Affecting Female Sports Journalists and Sports Coverage in Tanzania
literature.title_cn: 影响坦桑尼亚女性体育记者与体育报道的歧视与阻碍
literature.title_en: Discrimination and Deterrents Affecting Female Sports Journalists and Sports Coverage in Tanzania
literature.author: Dianus J. Ishengoma, Theodorah Munisi, Kelsey Slater
literature.abstract: Sports journalism, traditionally a male-dominated field, is undergoing a notable shift as women increasingly enter the profession, both in developed nations and across Africa. However, despite the progress made by women globally since the 1970s, compared to the Global North, the presence of female sports journalists remains low in Tanzania. Grounded in media feminism theory, this study explored the perceptions of women sports journalists regarding sports reporting, identifies the barriers they face, and examines the role of editors in promoting greater female participation in Tanzanian newsrooms. Data were collected through interviews with sports editors and female journalists from 10 media outlets based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. The findings reveal that while sports editors in Tanzania are making efforts to ensure equal opportunities and empowerment for women in sports coverage, a widespread negative public perception of female sports journalists persists. This study reveals that female sports journalists in Dar es Salaam continue to encounter challenges in interviewing sources and combating sexual harassment and gender-based violence.
literature.abstract_cn: 体育新闻传统上是一个以男性为主导的领域，如今正经历显著转变，越来越多的女性进入这一职业，无论是在发达国家还是在非洲各地。然而，尽管自20世纪70年代以来全球女性取得了进步，但与全球北方相比，坦桑尼亚女性体育记者的比例仍然很低。以媒介女性主义理论为基础，本研究探讨了女性体育记者对体育报道的看法，识别出她们面临的障碍，并考察了编辑在促进坦桑尼亚新闻编辑室中女性更多参与方面的作用。研究者通过对坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆10家媒体机构的体育编辑和女性记者进行访谈收集数据。研究结果显示，尽管坦桑尼亚的体育编辑正在努力确保女性在体育报道中获得平等机会和赋权，但公众对女性体育记者的普遍负面看法依然存在。本研究揭示，达累斯萨拉姆的女性体育记者在采访信源以及应对性骚扰和基于性别的暴力方面仍持续面临挑战。

literature.title: Audience Reactions to Sports Activism: The Role of Framing and Hostile Media Effects
literature.title_cn: 受众对体育行动主义的反应：框架与敌意媒体效应的作用
literature.title_en: Audience Reactions to Sports Activism: The Role of Framing and Hostile Media Effects
literature.author: Bumsoo Park, Minkyo Lee, Zack P. Pedersen
literature.abstract: While there are ongoing debates about separating sports from politics, sports entities (e.g., teams, leagues, and athletes) continue to engage in sociopolitical movements both on and off the field. Although these sports entities embrace these movements in various ways, the mainstream news media continues to play an important role in shaping public perceptions of these actions. The current study examined the influence of mainstream media framing and hostile media effects on individuals and their perceptions of sports activism, specifically in the context of sports executives. The current study employed an experimental design with a 2 (framing: episodic vs. thematic) × 2 (hostile media effects: favored vs. nonfavored) factorial setup, using a sample of 228 participants. A significant interaction between news media framing and hostile media effects was found, highlighting the importance of these constructs in information processing. Furthermore, participants’ interest in sociopolitical issues increased after exposure to news articles about sports activism. The ramifications of these findings are discussed particularly as they relate to the role of media in the sports landscape.
literature.abstract_cn: 尽管关于体育与政治是否应分离的争论仍在持续，体育实体（如球队、联盟和运动员）继续在赛场内外参与社会政治运动。尽管这些体育实体以各种方式接纳这些运动，主流新闻媒体在塑造公众对这些行为的认知方面仍扮演重要角色。本研究考察了主流媒体框架和敌意媒体效应（hostile media effects）对个体及其对体育激进主义（尤其是体育高管情境下）认知的影响。研究采用2（框架：片段式vs.主题式）×2（敌意媒体效应：偏好vs.非偏好）的因子实验设计，样本为228名参与者。研究发现新闻媒体框架与敌意媒体效应之间存在显著的交互作用，凸显了这些构念在信息处理中的重要性。此外，参与者在接触关于体育激进主义的新闻文章后，对社会政治议题的兴趣有所增加。研究者讨论了这些发现的深层影响，特别是它们与媒体在体育格局中所起作用的关系。
literature.theoretical_framework: 框架理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: How Fandom, Union Sentiment, and Game Knowledge Influence U.S. Sports Journalism Students’ Sympathies During a Major League Baseball Labor Dispute
literature.title_cn: 球迷热情、工会情绪与赛事知识如何影响美国体育新闻专业学生在大联盟棒球劳资纠纷中的立场
literature.title_en: How Fandom, Union Sentiment, and Game Knowledge Influence U.S. Sports Journalism Students’ Sympathies During a Major League Baseball Labor Dispute
literature.author: Talia Massi, Andrew Jordan, Ashley Greer, Sada Reed
literature.abstract: This study was conducted during the 2022 Major League Baseball lockout to determine how sports journalism students’ union sentiment, baseball fandom, and baseball knowledge could predict whether they sympathized more with management or players and their perception of the players’ union. We found that sports journalism students generally lean pro-union, and their baseball fandom fell into three fandom subcategories: appreciation for athletes’ physical skill, living vicariously through the athletes, and socialization/escapism. Students’ average score on the baseball strategy knowledge test was 65%. Results of a multiple regression found that the higher participants’ pro-union sentiment, escapism/socialization, and appreciation for physical skill, the more they sympathized with players during the lockout. The only significant predictor of a promanagement stance, however, was students’ antiunion sentiment. Using sports journalism students’ fandom, union sentiment, and baseball strategy knowledge, regression models could predict 83% and 84% of the variability in students’ respective proplayer and promanagement sympathies.

literature.title: Still the Outsiders? Women in Sport Journalism
literature.title_cn: 仍是局外人吗？女性在体育新闻中的处境
literature.title_en: Still the Outsiders? Women in Sport Journalism
literature.author: Alex Harris, Ali Bowes
literature.abstract: It has long been acknowledged that sport media is a male-dominated space, which has served to entrench women sport journalists’ position in the industry as outsiders. This research consisted of interviews with 10 women sport journalists working in the United Kingdom, exploring their workplace experiences. Drawing on Kanter’s theory of tokenism, findings indicate that women working in men’s sport face workplace practices that reinforce their outsider status. Participants discussed workplace harassment and gendered online abuse, numeric inequality, and the additional labor of fact checking and proving themselves to minimize their outsider status. In addition, this numeric inequality and outsider status leave women reluctant to raise issues, fearing career jeopardy, thus highlighting the precarious landscape that women face in the U.K. industry. However, there were suggestions that the increasing mediatization of women’s sport was indicative of newly emerging journalistic cultures that could lead to the greater acceptance of women in sport journalism.
literature.abstract_cn: 本研究聚焦女性在体育新闻中的边缘化处境。研究考察了体育新闻编辑室中女性记者的职业经历、职业晋升障碍与性别不平等现象。研究发现女性体育记者仍面临结构性性别歧视，包括晋升天花板、薪酬差距、性别化任务分配与工作环境中的性骚扰等问题，探讨了改善性别平等与推动女性体育新闻职业发展的路径。

literature.title: 组态视角下武术短视频传播效果的影响机理与提升策略——基于抖音19位体育博主的QCA分析
literature.title_cn: 组态视角下武术短视频传播效果的影响机理与提升策略——基于抖音19位体育博主的QCA分析
literature.author: 李成、丁保玉、解乒乒
literature.abstract: 短视频平台是数智时代体育文化传播的重要载体。研究从组态视角切入,以抖音19位体育博主的武术短视频传播情况为样本,运用定性比较分析法,揭示武术短视频传播效果的影响机理与提升策略。研究表明:主题类型、人物形象、叙事视角、叙事情节、传播平台、粉丝关注、粉丝社群等单一传播要素组成了武术短视频传播的充分必要条件,具体可归纳为故事叙事型、竞技展演型、生活娱乐型三种组态路径。提升策略包括:借助数字技术充分挖掘武术资源,讲好中华武术故事;呼吁用户广泛参与武术文化传播,强化武术民族认同;注重武术传播行动者对日常习武场景的记录,赓续武术传承根脉。

literature.abstract: 该研究运用文献资料和逻辑分析等方法,对数字媒介时代健身直播秀传播的内在逻辑、现实问题和优化策略进行了探究,以期为推动健身直播秀的高效发展、助力全民健身和体育强国战略目标的快速实现提供镜鉴。研究发现,健身直播秀作为互联网时代的产物,对于身体技术、媒介技术与资本逻辑的耦合运作具有内在必然性,其传播过程折射出数字媒介时代体育传播的新样态。

literature.abstract: 体育对外话语的情感传达与民心相通,形成中国体育对外话语的柔性链接与共情纽带。进而厘清中国体育对外话语体系建构的内在逻辑:体育文化符号共情传播的传递逻辑;体育对外话语情感叙事与交流的对话逻辑;受众视角对体育语言情感解读的理解逻辑。据此,提出构建更有效力的中国体育对外话语体系的传播路径。

literature.abstract: 中华体育精神传播经历了有限交往、向世界说明中国、让世界听到中国声音、讲好中国故事、构建人类命运共同体5个阶段,实现了由局部转向全面,由被动转向主动,由他塑转向自塑,由对外宣传到对外传播再到国际传播。在这一过程中,中华体育精神传播历经两次重大转型,一是新技术与新平台引领的传播媒介融合,二是以推动构建人类命运共同体为目标的国际传播价值转向。

literature.title_cn: 体育国际传播的共情机制：成都大运会赛事亲和力的短视频建构
literature.author: 刘臻睿、钟新、蒋贤成
literature.abstract: 体育重大赛事是展现一国国家形象、促进体育精神在全球传播的重要场合。作为2023年中国举办的一场国际大学生体育盛会，成都大运会承载着展现成都城市文化及中国国家形象的重要职能。研究基于成都大运会期间不同渠道、不同形式的媒体视频的传播实践，对体育国际传播的共情机制展开探析。研究发现，大运会中的不同参与主体通过从内在到外在的多重机制实现了在地共情，云端视频技术与数字媒体内容搭建了网络共情空间。

literature.title: Between global events and local reverberations: Globalization, local media framing and the 2014 FIFA World Cup
literature.title_cn: 全球事件与本地回响之间：全球化、地方媒体框架与2014年FIFA世界杯
literature.title_en: Between global events and local reverberations: Globalization, local media framing and the 2014 FIFA World Cup
literature.author: Petersen‐Wagner, Lee Ludvigsen
literature.abstract: Abstract This article advances sociological work on globalization processes. It concerns itself with conceptualizations of how the local and global ‘clash’, utilizing Ulrich Beck's work on globalization, cosmopolitanism and power. By employing Brazil's 2014 Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) men's World Cup as a case, this article seeks to build on Beck's theorizations, into the field of football; using the General Law of the World Cup as a symbolic representation for the global/local, interest‐driven interactions between Brazil and FIFA. In particular, this article is concerned with how FIFA's requirements, standards and norms, as imposed on the host nation, were framed within local media and journalistic discourses. The article extends Beck's insights by problematizing how global demands meet local socio‐spatial, legal and cultural contexts and how these demands, seeking to regulate and secure consumption, are resisted by various domestic and localized actors situated within a power game.

literature.title: The Hundred: A sociological analysis of gender relations and the (semi-) professionalisation of women's cricket in England
literature.title_cn: The Hundred：英格兰女子板球性别关系与(半)职业化的社会学分析
literature.title_en: The Hundred: A sociological analysis of gender relations and the (semi-) professionalisation of women's cricket in England
literature.author: Thomas Fletcher, Philippa Velija, Rafaelle Nicholson
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: In this article, we adopt a critical sociological perspective to understanding gender relations and cricket, through the lens of The Hundred – a new, short-form tournament, described by the England and Wales Cricket Board as being part of its long-term commitment to making cricket a gender-equal sport. The Hundred is the first sporting tournament in the world which, from the outset, featured fully aligned competitions for both men's and women's teams, including equal prize money, but not equal pay, which the recent Independent Commission for Equity in Cricket condemned. Drawing on concepts of professionalisation as a gendered process we discuss data from interviews with 33 people working in cricket to consider how gender relations continue to impact opportunities for women in cricket. This article further supports the need to conceptualise professionalisation in sport as gendered by considering the ways The Hundred facilitates opportunities for men's and women's cricket differently.

literature.title: Ichiro, Ohtani, and the New Era for Japan-U.S. Baseball Diplomacy
literature.title_cn: 铃木一朗、大谷翔平与日美棒球外交的新时代
literature.title_en: Ichiro, Ohtani, and the New Era for Japan-U.S. Baseball Diplomacy
literature.author: Derek Moscato
literature.abstract: Abstract: The Major League Baseball heroics of Japanese baseball players such as Ichiro Suzuki and Shohei Ohtani represent the culmination of decades of pan-Pacific sporting exchange, a phenomenon that has engaged athletes, coaches, and sporting fans across North America, Asia, and the world. This transnational narrative of binational professional mobility and sporting diplomacy has also served as a touchstone for players from the United States who have made successful careers of their own in Japan, and specifically Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). The list of expatriate players who have starred in Japan includes Randy Bass, Greg “Boomer” Wells, Wally Yonamine, and Karl “Tuffy” Rhodes. The two-way flow of baseball between Japan and the United States, going back over a century and a half, is marked by the individual stories of American and Japanese players who trailblazed their playing careers overseas, as well as contemporary touchstones like the World Baseball Classic, which has transformed the way the sport is followed and understood globally.

literature.title: Examining Audiences’ Information-Seeking Behavior Surrounding the Super Bowl and Sex Trafficking: Insights From Google Trends Data
literature.title_cn: 审视受众围绕超级碗与性交易的寻求信息行为：来自谷歌趋势数据的洞见
literature.title_en: Examining Audiences’ Information-Seeking Behavior Surrounding the Super Bowl and Sex Trafficking: Insights From Google Trends Data
literature.author: Wenche Wang, Stacy-Lynn Sant, Elizabeth King
literature.abstract: Sex trafficking is a prominent human rights issue that has been increasingly associated with the hosting of large-scale sport events. Despite insufficient evidence demonstrating a causal or correlative link, event stakeholders have implemented antitrafficking efforts in attempts to prevent and promote awareness of sex trafficking. Using Google Trends data to measure audiences’ information-seeking behavior online and Twitter data as a proxy for antitrafficking efforts on social media, we employed a difference-in-differences approach to estimate the change in online demand for sex-trafficking information among the residents of Miami-Dade, the host city of Super Bowl LIV (54). Findings highlight an increase in the online demand for sex-trafficking information in the host city during and after the event. This increased demand attributed to the Super Bowl may offer support for host communities utilizing sport events to promote awareness of pressing social issues.

literature.title: Money talks: Analysing the PGA Tour-LIV Golf jurisdictional contest via Western media narratives
literature.title_cn: 金钱说话：通过西方媒体叙事分析PGA巡回赛对LIV高尔夫的管辖权之争
literature.title_en: Money talks: Analysing the PGA Tour-LIV Golf jurisdictional contest via Western media narratives
literature.author: Nicholas Jephson, Jonathan Grix, Hugh Cook
literature.source_name: International Review for the Sociology of Sport
literature.abstract: This paper analyses Western media narratives of the jurisdictional contest between LIV Golf, a novel upstart professional golf tour, and the long-established PGA Tour, generally understood to be the pinnacle of men's professional golf. In doing so, the paper seeks to answer two research questions: How do dominant incumbent sporting professions utilise the court of public opinion to defend their territory from encroachment by new rivals? What are the potential implications of such professions’ failure to successfully do so? Viewed through the lens of Abbott’s concept of ‘bump-chains’, this paper shines critical light on how the long-established and dominant PGA Tour and its partisan (but not full contingent of) members initially sought to defend their territory against encroachment by a new entrant to the profession of competitive golf, before capitulating and proposing a ‘merger’ with LIV Golf in June 2023, which as of July 2024, has still not materialised, nor the finer details even made public. Utilising a critical qualitative analysis of popular Western-centric news media sources, the paper argues that the PGA Tour adopted a three-fold set of defensive rhetorical manoeuvres to seek to de-professionalise LIV Golf and discredit it in the court of public opinion as a convincing rival to the incumbent profession. It concludes that the PGA Tour's rhetorical defence attempts and thus its position as a dominant superordinate were untenable in the face of the new entrant's reach and power. In doing so, the paper adds theoretical depth to our understanding of bump-chain attacks within the sporting arena, and also acts to highlight sporting jurisdictions’ vulnerabilities to encroachment by previously unconsidered entities. These findings bring implications for governing bodies and institutions in the sporting arena concerning the strength of their jurisdictional positions, extending beyond professional boundaries.

literature.title: Throwing Them Under the Bus: The Framing of a Critical Incident at the Tour de France
literature.title_cn: 把他们扔到车下：环法自行车赛重大事故的框架呈现
literature.title_en: Throwing Them Under the Bus: The Framing of a Critical Incident at the Tour de France
literature.author: Ryan Snelgrove, Laura Wood, Larena Hoeber, Orland Hoeber
literature.abstract: In the context of sport events, several stakeholders’ reputations could be impacted by critical incidents, including event organizers, athletes, teams, countries represented by athletes, and sponsors. The purposes of this study were to develop an understanding of (a) how an event organizer, media, and the public framed a critical incident in a rhetorical arena and (b) how frames were connected with the reputations of event stakeholders immediately following a critical incident. A three-phase approach was employed that involved collecting and analyzing data from X/Twitter about a bus crash at the 2013 Tour de France. The critical incident was framed in nine different ways, many of which were emergent. Findings demonstrated that critical incidents at a sport event are interpreted and framed in multiple ways and can have an impact on the reputations of the event and other event stakeholders.

literature.title: Fight Within a Fight: Negotiating Narratives in a UFC Bout's Hype Videos
literature.title_cn: 战斗中的战斗：UFC赛事宣传视频中叙事协商
literature.title_en: Fight Within a Fight: Negotiating Narratives in a UFC Bout's Hype Videos
literature.author: Elias Gbadamosi, Michael Lee Humphrey
literature.abstract: Abstract: This paper critically examines how controlled violence and hyperbolic hype narratives in the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) are potent in shaping sports-media discourse by interrogating the symbolic and formal representations embedded in the lead-up to and aftermath of the high-profile UFC 268 rematch between Kamaru Usman and Colby Covington at Madison Square Garden, New York. Our analysis of the promotional videos for this monumental fight and the YouTube comments accompanying those videos, using the Burkean–small stories analysis method we developed, reveals how differing audience perspectives negotiate the interplay between politically charged narratives and performative spectacle. The findings argue that while the UFC exploits narratives of conflict interspersed with tinctures of identity politics to purposefully court controversy in a bid to garner massive viewership, their narratives hold the potential to enrich democratic discourse as they forge a fertile ground for pluralistic public engagement. This study underscores the need to explore further how commercialized media spectacle can mobilize broader narrative engagement and foment sociopolitical and cultural divisions.
literature.theoretical_framework: 叙事理论、受众研究理论

literature.title: An Analysis of Agenda Setting and Framing of American Marathon Television Coverage
literature.title_cn: 美国马拉松电视报道的议程设置与框架分析
literature.title_en: An Analysis of Agenda Setting and Framing of American Marathon Television Coverage
literature.author: Michael Clemons, Austin C. Bogina
literature.abstract: This study examined nationally televised marathon coverage of three major U.S. marathons (the Boston Marathon, the Bank of America Chicago Marathon, and the Tata Consultancy Services New York City Marathon) to understand how able-bodied men and women, and men and women using wheelchairs were represented. Just under 8 hr of coverage was analyzed for clock time and the descriptions of athletes divided by divisions of able-bodied men and women and wheelchair athlete men and women. Able-bodied women received the majority of clock time in Boston and Chicago, while able-bodied men received the majority of clock time in New York City. Athletes using wheelchairs, both men and women, received much smaller amounts of coverage, especially in New York City. Women received more announcer mentions in all three races, with a heavier focus on their background, coaching, and emotion, although the only statistically significant category was emotion. Experience and race strategy/training were heavily emphasized for all divisions. Through this analysis, race producers have more guidance on how to cover future marathons in a more equitable and appropriate manner.

literature.title: From Gearshifts to Gigabytes: An Analysis of How NASCAR Used iRacing to Engage Fans During the COVID-19 Shutdown
literature.title_cn: 从换挡到千兆字节：NASCAR如何在疫情停摆期间用iRacing吸引车迷
literature.title_en: From Gearshifts to Gigabytes: An Analysis of How NASCAR Used iRacing to Engage Fans During the COVID-19 Shutdown
literature.author: Greg Greenhalgh; Chad Goebert
literature.abstract: The sport industry is at an inflection point where all major professional sport leagues in North America are struggling to attract the same avid fans, once a staple within the industry. Furthermore, not only are the number of avid fans decreasing, the average age of avid sport fans is increasing. In other words, the current state of the sport industry indicates that fans are decreasing in number while simultaneously aging out of traditional professional sports. The current study aimed to investigate the ability of a traditional sport, NASCAR (National Association for Stock Car Auto Racing) in this case, to utilize an esport, iRacing, to attract new and more diverse fans. Through a partnership with Zoomph, Twitter content was analyzed and revealed the shift from traditional racing to iRacing by NASCAR. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, it assisted them in attracting new, more diverse fans whose sentiment on Twitter was positive. Overall, the current study demonstrated that traditional sport properties may be well served by tapping into the esport space in an authentic way to enhance their core product(s).

literature.title_en: Factors driving FIFA world cup 2022 viewership ratings in mainland China: marketing outlooks for FIFA world cup 2026
literature.author: Zongqing Wang, Lide Su, Agudamu, Tao Gong, Te Bu, Yang Zhang
literature.source_name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
literature.abstract: IntroductionThe FIFA World Cup is not only the most lucrative athletic event globally, but it also functions as a platform for promoting peace owing to FIFA's new vision. Nevertheless, the determinants of TV viewership ratings, especially in the Chinese market, which is a critical revenue stream for FIFA TV broadcasting, are still unsolved. Using a distributional regression, this study aimed to quantify the dynamics of viewership ratings for the FIFA World Cup 2022 in mainland China.MethodsThe CCTV viewership ratings were modeled using 12 covariables related to Chinese TV consumer behavior. Given the data structure, a Logit Normal regression model was chosen to fit the location and dispersion parameters of viewership ratings to explanatory variables.ResultsIn the fitted heteroscedastic model, the viewership ratings dynamics in mainland China were driven by the match kick-off time: μ^=logistic[−4.874+0.043×matchkick-offtime]. In addition, the model captures the factors that influence the variations in viewership ratings: σ^=exp[−14.26–1.346 (if, FIFA World Cup champion = “Yes”) + 0.004 × FIFA world ranking]. Thus, it shows that the FIFA World Cup champions tamp down such variations, leading to a more stable viewing behavior among Chinese consumers.ConclusionsTime- and team-sensitive strategies are proposed to aid in crafting uncertainty-suppressing business decisions for the FIFA World Cup 2026. Ultimately, in the more insecure 2020s, a broader live coverage of the FIFA World Cup would be invaluable for promoting peace.

literature.author: Aliaa Dakroury
literature.abstract: Abstract: Research on mega sports events often emphasizes the way hosting nations use these opportunities to showcase their positive national image to the global audience. This study, however, presents an intriguing example of blending politics with a major sports event, by examining the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022—hosted for the first time in an Islamic, Arab, and non-Western country. A qualitative critical analysis was conducted to compare media narratives surrounding the event, focusing on Arab versus Western media coverage beyond the soccer matches themselves. Data were collected from November 18, 2022, to December 20, 2022 (i.e., the FIFA tournament time frame), using keyword searches on the Factiva database, which includes all international daily media in both English and Arabic. No content was excluded from the search, covering all sections of the media, including but not limited to news articles, opinion pieces, and commentaries. Results showed that the coverage went indeed beyond a mere mega sports event, with media focusing on human rights and the conditions of migrant workers in Qatar. Meanwhile, Arab media highlighted the double standards in coverage issues of alcohol consumption, human rights, and sexual orientation, emphasizing discourses on nationalism, Islam, Palestine, and Orientalism.

literature.title_cn: 叙事中的“新高度”？跨国分析转播机构残奥会社交媒体报道的考量
literature.title_en: “New Heights” in Storytelling?: Considerations for Cross-National Analyses of Broadcasters’ Social Media Coverage of the Paralympics
literature.author: Dunja Antunovic, Andrea Bundon, Lindsey Lehrfeld, Peter Gancayco
literature.abstract: Prior to the 2022 Beijing Paralympic Games, rights-holding broadcasters in multiple countries promised record-amount of coverage, including on digital platforms. This paper analyzes how NBC and CBC, the broadcasters in the U.S. and Canada, respectively, utilized social media platforms during the Paralympic Games. We employed two methodological approaches. The first draws on agenda diversity literature to provide a quantitative, descriptive analysis of Paralympics-related posts, interactions with other accounts, and gender representations. The second approach draws on research on the televisual logic of digital media to identify and interpret presentation, sequence, and visualization patterns. Our multidimensional analysis found differences in the volume of Paralympics-related posts and the utilization of interactive elements, across the two broadcasters. The coverage on both accounts highlighted home-nation athletes and their competitions, which shaped gender representations and the rhythm of social media coverage. Both broadcasters followed established sequences of mega-events, with the exception of an international conflict. CBC relied primarily on one journalist to provide updates and curling-related recaps, while NBC directed audiences to watch sports where U.S. athletes succeeded. We discuss the theoretical and methodological implications of cross-national comparative coverage of the Paralympics.
